title: Repayment Plan Installments Withheld from Claim Payment Runs (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
This rule of the **Network Participation Agreements** covers the first installment of a repayment plan that Cascade withholds from a claim payment run of an agreement paid by claim payments rather than by capitation. It covers only that first plan installment.

## Scope among the practice's agreements

Overpayments are recovered at the level of the practice: an open overpayment under one agreement may be offset against remittances under any active or termination pending agreement of the same practice, except that a continuing capitation withholding, a continuing run withholding, a post-decision withholding and a plan installment each select only among the overpayments of the agreement whose payment they are withheld from, and only those four do.

## Order and limits of offsets

Open overpayments of the practice are offset oldest notice first, except that a continuing capitation withholding and a continuing run withholding go to the overpayment the agreement's most recent withholding was applied to, a post-decision withholding goes to the overpayment of the agreement's most recent dispute decision and a plan installment goes to the overpayment the plan down payment was recorded against, and only those four withholdings follow these selections instead of notice order; the total withheld from a claim payment run may not exceed the agreement type's recoupment percentage of that run's claim payments, while a withholding from a capitation payment is measured against the capitation amount itself, at the agreement type's recoupment percentage of it for the first withholding of an overpayment and at the continuing capitation withholding share for a continuing capitation withholding.

## Refund window and the start of offsets

The practice may refund within the refund window of calendar days after the notice; an overpayment may be offset against a remittance only after the refund window following the overpayment notice has passed and while no dispute of it is pending, except that a plan installment this policy governs may be withheld from an overpayment the practice has placed in its repayment plan before that overpayment's refund window has passed, and only such a plan installment; every other withholding remains bound by the refund window.

The offset may start on the day after the notice date plus the refund window of calendar days, except that a plan installment this policy governs may be withheld from an overpayment of the plan whose refund window has not yet passed, and only such a plan installment; every other offset starts no earlier than that day.

The refund window is the agreement type's figure in the product's payment integrity table.

## When the installment is withheld

The first plan installment is withheld only after the practice's down payment is recorded on the ledger against its open overpayments.

## Effect

Cascade books the installment against the claim payment run. The booking lowers the open amount of the overpayment named by the installment, and it shows on the run's remittance advice as an amount withheld.

## Invocation: `book_plan_installment_e88126b0`

**Capability.** The tool books an installment of a practice's repayment plan against a claim payment run of an agreement: Cascade keeps the installment from that run's claim payments. One call adds one installment withholding entry to the agreement's overpayment ledger.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `provider_agreement_id` | Reference number of the network participation agreement whose claim payment run is withheld from, as returned by the agreement lookup for the practice | Id |
| `original_payment_event_id` | Reference number of the overpayment notice entry the installment is booked against, as returned by the provider payment and overpayment lookup for that agreement | Id |
| `remittance_number` | Remittance advice number of the claim payment run withheld from, copied character for character from the remittance entry, preserving every letter, digit and hyphen with no normalisation | Verbatim text |
| `installment_amount` | The installment kept from the run | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent by the caller |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the booking:

- `status`: the text "booked" when the installment entry was added;
- `entry_id`: reference number of the new installment entry;
- `provider_agreement_id`: echoed;
- `overpayment_case_number`: case number of the overpayment the installment was booked against;
- `remittance_number`: echoed;
- `amount`: USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date`: date YYYY-MM-DD.
